title: Outeniqua Transport Museum
scope: The mapped former PX goods shed occupied by the Outeniqua Transport Museum in George. Excludes the separate historic station, surrounding buildings, tracks and collection objects.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: First-person railway preservation account identifies the existing PX goods shed on Mission Road as the museum venue.
Local tourism office identifies the museum and its current site.
Mapped named museum envelope, revision 9, January 2026.
2026 main shed rectangle 153.56 × 95.379 m, corroborates the named OSM footprint.
Transnet scope describes main entrance facilities and a brick museum section.

limitations: The named OSM envelope is used in full. George Municipality’s two matching 2026 building polygons independently check the main shed length, span and small returns.

The roof pitch and three spans, exact gates, entry facade openings and material colors are estimates. The public-domain photo constrains the rail-side cladding and visible trim only. Possible storm repairs and the status of verandah additions are not modeled.
The original terrain samples stay unchanged. The finished floor, individual thresholds and apron heights are approximate.
